   item[\"last_confirm_evidence\"] = json.loads(item[\"last_confirm_evidence\"])\r\n                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):\r\n                        item[\"last_confirm_evidence\"] = None\r\n            return items\r\n\r\n    def check_invoice_conflicts(self, invoice_no: str = None) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            if invoice_no:\r\n                rows = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"SELECT m.*, i.invoice_no, i.invoice_date, i.customer as inv_customer,\r\n                              i.amount as inv_amount, p.payment_no, p.payment_date,\r\n                              p.customer as pay_customer, p.amount as pay_amount\r\n                       FROM matches m\r\n                       JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                       LEFT JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                       WHERE i.invoice_no = ?\r\n                       ORDER BY m.created_at\"\"\",\r\n                    (invoice_no,)\r\n                ).fetchall()\r\n            else:\r\n                rows = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"SELECT m.*, i.invoice_no, i.invoice_date, i.customer as inv_customer,\r\n                              i.amount as inv_amount, p.payment_no, p.payment_date,\r\n                              p.customer as pay_customer, p.amount as pay_amount\r\n                       FROM matches m\r\n                       JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                       LEFT JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                       ORDER BY i.invoice_no, m.created_at\"\"\",\r\n                ).fetchall()\r\n\r\n            invoice_matches = {}\r\n            for r in rows:\r\n                inv_no = r[\"invoice_no\"]\r\n                if inv_no not in invoice_matches:\r\n                    invoice_matches[inv_no] = []\r\n                invoice_matches[inv_no].append(dict(r))\r\n\r\n            conflicts = []\r\n            for inv_no, matches in invoice_matches.items():\r\n                operators = set()\r\n                active_count = 0\r\n                for m in matches:\r\n                    if m[\"operator\"]:\r\n                        operators.add(m[\"operator\"])\r\n                    if m[\"status\"] != MATCH_STATUS_REVOKED:\r\n                        active_count += 1\r\n                if len(matches) > 1 and len(operators) > 1:\r\n                    conflicts.append({\r\n                        \"invoice_no\": inv_no,\r\n                        \"match_count\": len(matches),\r\n                        \"active_count\": active_count,\r\n                        \"operators\": list(operators),\r\n                        \"matches\": matches\r\n                    })\r\n            return conflicts\r\n\r\n    def get_user(self, username: str) -> Optional[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            row = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?\",\r\n                (username,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n            return dict(row) if row else None\r\n\r\n    def create_user(self, username: str, role: str = USER_ROLE_REVIEWER,\r\n                    status: str = USER_STATUS_ACTIVE) -> int:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            cursor = conn.execute(\r\n                \"\"\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (username, role, status)\r\n                   VALUES (?, ?, ?)\"\"\",\r\n                (username, role, status)\r\n            )\r\n            if cursor.lastrowid == 0:\r\n                row = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?\",\r\n                    (username,)\r\n                ).fetchone()\r\n                return row[\"id\"]\r\n            return cursor.lastrowid\r\n\r\n    def update_user_role(self, username: str, role: WHERE username = ?\",\r\n                (role, username)\r\n            )\r\n\r\n    def list_users(self) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            rows = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY username\"\r\n            ).fetchall()\r\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n\r\n    def get_match_lock(self, match_id: int) -> Optional[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            row = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\",\r\n                (match_id,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n            return dict(row) if row else None\r\n\r\n    def is_lock_expired(self, match_id: int) -> bool:\r\n        lock = self.get_match_lock(match_id)\r\n        if not lock:\r\n            return False\r\n        if not lock.get(\"lock_expires_at\"):\r\n            return False\r\n        try:\r\n            expire_time = datetime.strptime(\r\n                lock[\"lock_expires_at\"], \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"\r\n            )\r\n            return expire_time <= datetime.now()\r\n        except (ValueError, TypeError):\r\n            return False\r\n\r\n    def get_locks_by_owner(self, owner: str) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            rows = conn.execute(\r\n                \"\"\"SELECT ml.*, m.match_no, m.status as match_status,\r\n                          i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                   FROM match_locks ml\r\n                   JOIN matches m ON ml.match_id = m.id\r\n                   JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                   JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                   WHERE ml.lock_owner = ?\r\n                   ORDER BY ml.locked_at DESC\"\"\",\r\n                (owner,)\r\n            ).fetchall()\r\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n\r\n    def get_expired_locks(self, now: datetime = None) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        if now is None:\r\n            now = datetime.now()\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            rows = conn.execute(\r\n                \"\"\"SELECT ml.*, m.match_no, m.status as match_status,\r\n                          i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                   FROM match_locks ml\r\n                   JOIN matches m ON ml.match_id = m.id\r\n                   JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                   JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                   WHERE ml.lock_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND ml.lock_expires_at <= ?\r\n                   ORDER BY ml.lock_expires_at\"\"\",\r\n                (now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"),)\r\n            ).fetchall()\r\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n\r\n    def list_all_locks(self, include_expired: bool = False) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            if include_expired:\r\n                rows = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"SELECT ml.*, m.match_no, m.status as match_status,\r\n                              i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                       FROM match_locks ml\r\n                       JOIN matches m ON ml.match_id = m.id\r\n                       JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                       JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                       ORDER BY ml.locked_at DESC\"\"\"\r\n                ).fetchall()\r\n            else:\r\n                now = datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n                rows = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"SELECT ml.*, m.match_no, m.status as match_status,\r\n                              i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                       FROM match_locks ml\r\n                       JOIN matches m ON ml.match_id = m.id\r\n                       JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                       JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                       WHERE ml.lock_expires_at IS NULL OR ml.lock_expires_at > ?\r\n                       ORDER BY ml.locked_at DESC\"\"\",\r\n                    (now,)\r\n                ).fetchall()\r\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n\r\n    def acquire_lock(self, match_id: int, owner: str, reason: str = None,\r\n                     expire_seconds: int = None) -> Dict:\r\n        match = self.get_match_by_id(match_id)\r\n        if not match:\r\n            raise ValueError(f\"匹配记录不存在: {match_id}\")\r\n\r\n        now = datetime.now()\r\n        expires_at = None\r\n        if expire_seconds and expire_seconds > 0:\r\n            from datetime import timedelta\r\n            expires_at = now + timedelta(seconds=expire_seconds)\r\n            expires_at_str = expires_at.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n        else:\r\n            expires_at_str = None\r\n\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            existing = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\",\r\n                (match_id,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n\r\n            if existing:\r\n                existing_expires = existing[\"lock_expires_at\"]\r\n                if existing_expires:\r\n                    expire_time = datetime.strptime(existing_expires, \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n                    if expire_time > now:\r\n                        if existing[\"lock_owner\"] == owner:\r\n                            return {\r\n                                \"success\": True,\r\n                                \"already_locked\": True,\r\n                                \"match_id\": match_id,\r\n                                \"match_no\": match[\"match_no\"],\r\n                                \"owner\": owner,\r\n                                \"message\": \"您已锁定该记录\"\r\n                            }\r\n                        raise ValueError(\r\n                            f\"记录已被 {existing['lock_owner']} 锁定，\"\r\n                            f\"锁定时间: {existing['locked_at']}\"\r\n                        )\r\n\r\n            if existing:\r\n                conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"UPDATE match_locks\r\n                       SET lock_owner = ?, lock_reason = ?, locked_at = ?,\r\n                           lock_expires_at = ?\r\n                       WHERE match_id = ?\"\"\",\r\n                    (owner, reason, now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"),\r\n                     expires_at_str, match_id)\r\n                )\r\n            else:\r\n                conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"INSERT INTO match_locks\r\n                       (match_id, lock_owner, lock_reason, locked_at, lock_expires_at)\r\n                       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\"\"\",\r\n                    (match_id, owner, reason,\r\n                     now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"), expires_at_str)\r\n                )\r\n\r\n            old_owner = existing[\"lock_owner\"] if existing else None\r\n            self._record_lock_history(\r\n                conn, match_id, LOCK_ACTION_LOCK, owner, reason,\r\n                old_owner, owner\r\n            )\r\n\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": True,\r\n                \"already_locked\": False,\r\n                \"match_id\": match_id,\r\n                \"match_no\": match[\"match_no\"],\r\n                \"owner\": owner,\r\n                \"locked_at\": now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"),\r\n                \"expires_at\": expires_at_str,\r\n                \"message\": \"锁定成功\"\r\n            }\r\n\r\n    def release_lock(self, match_id: int, operator: str, reason: str = None) -> Dict:\r\n        match = self.get_match_by_id(match_id)\r\n        if not match:\r\n            raise ValueError(f\"匹配记录不存在: {match_id}\")\r\n\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            existing = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\",\r\n                (match_id,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n\r\n            if not existing:\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": False,\r\n existing[\"lock_owner\"]\r\n\r\n            conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\", (match_id,))\r\n\r\n            self._record_lock_history(\r\n                conn, match_id, transfer_lock(self, match_id: int, from_owner: str, to_owner: str,\r\n                      reason: str = None) -> Dict:\r\n        match = self.get_match_by_id(match_id)\r\n        if not match:\r\n            raise ValueError(f\"匹配记录不存在: {match_id}\")\r\n\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            existing = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\",\r\n                (match_id,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n\r\n            if not existing:\r\n                raise ValueError(\"该记录未被锁定，无法转交\")\r\n\r\n            if existing[\"lock_owner\"] != from_owner:\r\n                raise ValueError(\r\n                    f\"当前锁定人是 {existing['lock_owner']}，\"\r\n                    f\"不是 {from_owner}，无法转交\"\r\n                )\r\n\r\n            conn.execute(\r\n                \"UPDATE match_locks SET lock_owner = ? WHERE match_id = ?\",\r\n                (to_owner, match_id)\r\n            )\r\n\r\n            self._record_lock_history(\r\n                conn, match_id, LOCK_ACTION_TRANSFER, from_owner, ValueError(f\"匹配记录不存在: {match_id}\")\r\n\r\n        now = datetime.now()\r\n\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n            existing = conn.execute(\r\n                \"SELECT * FROM LOCK_ACTION_TAKEOVER, operator, reason,\r\n                    None, operator\r\n                )\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": True,\r\n                    \"match_id\": match_id,\r\n                    \"match_no\": match[\"match_no\"],\r\n                    \"old_owner\": None,\r\n                    \"new_owner\": operator,\r\n        if expire_time <= now:\r\n                    is_expired = True\r\n\r\n            if not is_expired and old_owner == operator:\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": operator,\r\n                    \"message\": \"您已锁定该记录\"\r\n                }\r\n\r\n            conn.execute(\r\n                \"\"\"UPDATE match_locks\r\n                   SET lock_owner = ?, %H:%M:%S\"), match_id)\r\n            )\r\n\r\n            self._record_lock_history(\r\n                conn, match_id, LOCK_ACTION_TAKEOVER, operator, reason,\r\n                old_owner, }\r\n\r\n    def force_unlock(self, match_id: int, operator: str,\r\n                     reason: str = None) -> Dict:\r\n        match = self.get_match_by_id(match_id)\r\n        if not match:\r\n ?\",\r\n                (match_id,)\r\n            ).fetchone()\r\n\r\n            if not existing:\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": False,\r\n existing[\"lock_owner\"]\r\n\r\n            conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM match_locks WHERE match_id = ?\", (match_id,))\r\n\r\n            self._record_lock_history(\r\n                conn, match_id,   rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM match_locks\").fetchall()\r\n\r\n            if not rows:\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": True,\r\n                    \"count\":    }\r\n\r\n    def get_lock_history(self, match_id: int = None,\r\n                         operator: str = None,\r\n                         limit: int = 100) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with       (match_id, action, operator, reason, old_owner, new_owner)\r\n        )\r\n\r\n    def is_match_locked_by_other(self, match_id: int, operator: str) -> bool:\r\n        lock =       return result\r\n\r\n    def get_match_with_lock_by_id(self, match_id: int) -> Optional[Dict]:\r\n        match = self.get_match_by_id(match_id)\r\n        if not match:\r\n            return     match[\"is_lock_expired\"] = expire_time <= datetime.now()\r\n            else:\r\n                match[\"is_lock_expired\"] = False\r\n        else:\r\n            match[\"current_owner\"] = match[\"is_lock_expired\"] = False\r\n\r\n        return match\r\n\r\n    def insert_batch_conflict(self, batch_id: int, conflict_type: str, record_type: str,\r\n return [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n\r\n    def set_session_state(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:\r\n        import json\r\n        value_str = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)\r\n        with = dict(b)\r\n                batch_id_val = batch[\"id\"]\r\n                file_type = batch[\"file_type\"]\r\n\r\n                inv_stats = conn.execute(\r\n                    \"\"\"SELECT\r\n result\r\n\r\n    def get_matches_by_batch(self, batch_id: int, status: str = None,\r\n                             operator: str = None) -> List[Dict]:\r\n        with self._get_conn() as conn:\r\n \"duplicate_process\"\r\nCONFLICT_TYPE_AMOUNT_CHANGE = \"amount_change\"\r\n\r\nCONFLICT_TYPE_LABELS = {\r\n    CONFLICT_TYPE_NEW_RECORD: \"新增记录\",\r\n    CONFLICT_TYPE_STATUS_CHANGE: \"状态冲突\",\r\n    CONFLICT_TYPE_DUPLICATE_PROCESS: \"重复处理\",\r\n    CONFLICT_TYPE_AMOUNT_CHANGE: \"金额变更\",\r\n}\r\n\r\n\r\nclass CSVImporter:\r\n    def __init__(self, config: Config, db: Database):\r\n        self.config = config\r\n        self.db = db\r\n\r\n    def import_invoices(self, file_path: str, operator: str = None) -> Dict:\r\n        return self._import_file(file_path, \"invoice\", file_path: str, file_type: str, operator: str = None) -> Dict:\r\n        if not os.path.exists(file_path):\r\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"文件不存在: {file_path}\")\r\n\r\n        existing_batch = self.db.check_file_imported(file_path, file_type)\r\n        if existing_batch:\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": True,\r\n                \"skipped\": True,\r\n                \"batch_id\": existing_batch[\"id\"],\r\n                \"message\": f\"文件已导入，批次ID: {existing_batch['id']}，跳过重复导入\",\r\n                \"total_rows\": existing_batch[\"total_rows\"],\r\n                \"success_rows\": existing_batch[\"success_rows\"],\r\n                \"failed_rows\": existing_batch[\"failed_rows\"]\r\n            }\r\n\r\n        required_columns = (\r\n            self.config.invoice_required_columns\r\n            if file_type == \"invoice\"\r\n            else self.config.payment_required_columns\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        with open(file_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\") as f:\r\n            reader = csv.DictReader(f)\r\n            headers = reader.fieldnames or []\r\n\r\n            missing_cols = [c for c in required_columns if c not in headers]\r\n            if missing_cols:\r\n                raise ValueError(\r\n                    f\"缺少必填列: {', '.join(missing_cols)}。\"\r\n                    f\"现有列: {', '.join(headers)}\"\r\n                )\r\n\r\n            rows = list(reader)\r\n            total_rows = len(rows)\r\n\r\n            file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)\r\n            batch_id = self.db.create_batch(\r\n                file_type, file_path, file_name, total_rows, operator\r\n            )\r\n\r\n            success_count = 0\r\n            failed_count = 0\r\n            conflict_count = 0\r\n\r\n            for idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=2):\r\n                result = self._validate_and_insert_row(\r\n                    batch_id, idx, row, file_type, required_columns\r\n                )\r\n                if result[\"success\"]:\r\n                    success_count += 1\r\n                else:\r\n                    failed_count += 1\r\n                    self.db.insert_error(\r\n                        batch_id, file_type, idx,\r\n                        result[\"error_type\"], result[\"error_message\"],\r\n                        json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False)\r\n                    )\r\n\r\n            self.db.update_batch_stats(batch_id, success_count, failed_count)\r\n\r\n            conflicts = self._detect_batch_conflicts(batch_id, file_type, operator)\r\n            conflict_count = len(conflicts)\r\n\r\n            from .change_tracker import ChangeTracker\r\n            tracker = ChangeTracker(self.config, self.db)\r\n            change_result = tracker.detect_and_track_changes(batch_id, file_type, operator)\r\n\r\n            message = f\"导入完成：成功 {success_count} 条，失败 {failed_count} 条\"\r\n            if conflict_count > 0:\r\n                message += f\"，检测到 {conflict_count} 个冲突\"\r\n            if change_result[\"total_changes\"] > 0:\r\n                message += f\"，追踪到 {change_result['total_changes']} 条变更记录\"\r\n\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": True,\r\n                \"skipped\": False,\r\n                \"batch_id\": batch_id,\r\n                \"total_rows\": total_rows,\r\n                \"success_rows\": success_count,\r\n                \"failed_rows\": failed_count,\r\n                \"conflict_count\": conflict_count,\r\n                \"conflicts\": conflicts,\r\n                \"change_count\": change_result[\"total_changes\"],\r\n                \"changes_by_type\": change_result[\"changes_by_type\"],\r\n                \"impact_summary\": change_result[\"impact_summary\"],\r\n                \"change_log_ids\": change_result[\"change_log_ids\"],\r\n                \"message\": message\r\n            }\r\n\r\n    def _detect_batch_conflicts(self, batch_id: int, file_type: str,\r\n                                 new_operator: str = None) -> List[Dict]:\r\n [b[\"id\"] for b in prev_batches]\r\n\r\n        if file_type == \"invoice\":\r\n            for prev_batch_id in prev_batch_ids:\r\n                with self.db._get_conn() as conn:\r\n conflict_id,\r\n                        \"conflict_type\": CONFLICT_TYPE_NEW_RECORD,\r\n                        \"record_type\": \"invoice\",\r\n                        \"record_no\": invoice_no,\r\n new_amount = r[\"amount\"]\r\n                new_match_status = r[\"match_status\"]\r\n                new_pay_status = r[\"status\"]\r\n\r\n                if payment_no not in existing_records:\r\n       return conflicts\r\n\r\n    def _validate_and_insert_row(self, batch_id: int, file_row_num: int,\r\n                                 row: Dict, file_type: str,\r\n                                 required_columns: List[str]) -> Dict:\r\n        raw_data = json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False)\r\n\r\n        for col in required_columns:\r\n            if not row.get(col):\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": False,\r\n                    \"error_type\": ERROR_TYPE_MISSING_REQUIRED,\r\n                    \"error_message\": f\"缺少必填字段: {col}\"\r\n                }\r\n\r\n        if file_type == \"invoice\":\r\n            return self._validate_and_insert_invoice(\r\n                batch_id, file_row_num, row, raw_data\r\n            )\r\n        else:\r\n            return self._validate_and_insert_payment(\r\n                batch_id, file_row_num, row, raw_data\r\n            )\r\n\r\n    def _validate_and_insert_invoice(self, batch_id: int, file_row_num: int,\r\n                                     row: Dict, raw_data: str) -> Dict:\r\n        invoice_no = row[\"invoice_no\"].strip()\r\n        invoice_date_str = row[\"invoice_date\"].strip()\r\n        customer = row[\"customer\"].strip()\r\n        amount_str = row[\"amount\"].strip()\r\n\r\n        if not customer:\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": False,\r\n                \"error_type\": ERROR_TYPE_MISSING_CUSTOMER,\r\n                \"error_message\": \"客户名称为空\"\r\n            }\r\n\r\n        try:\r\n            amount = float(amount_str)\r\n            if amount <= 0:\r\n                return {\r\n                    \"success\": False,\r\n                    \"error_type\": ERROR_TYPE_INVALID_AMOUNT,\r\n                    \"error_message\": f\"金额非法: {amount_str}，必须为正数\"\r\n                }\r\n        except (ValueError, TypeError):\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": False,\r\n                \"error_type\": ERROR_TYPE_INVALID_AMOUNT,\r\n                \"error_message\": f\"金额格式错误: {amount_str}\"\r\n            }\r\n\r\n        invoice_date = self._parse_date(invoice_date_str)\r\n        if not invoice_date:\r\n            self.db.insert_invoice(\r\n                batch_id, file_row_num, invoice_no, None, customer,\r\n                amount, raw_data, INVOICE_STATUS_INVALID,\r\n                f\"日期格式错误: {invoice_date_str}\"\r\n            )\r\n            return {\r\n                \"success\": False,\r\n                \"error_type\": ERROR_TYPE_INVALID_DATE,\r\n                \"error_message\": f\"日期格式错误: {invoice_date_str}，请使用 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY/MM/DD 格式\"\r\n            }\r\n\r\n        status_raw = row.get(\"status\", \"正常\")\r\n        status =               from datetime import datetime\r\n                expire_time = datetime.strptime(lock[\"lock_expires_at\"], \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n                if expire_time <= else:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[OK] {result['message']}\", fg=\"green\"))\r\n            click.echo(f\"匹配编号: {result['match_no']}\")\r\n            click.echo(f\"持有人: pass\r\n\r\n\r\n@lock.command(\"list\")\r\n@click.option(\"--all\", \"show_all\", is_flag=True, help=\"显示所有锁（包括已过期）\")\r\n@click.option(\"--owner\", default=None, workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    current_operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    if owner:\r\n        locks = workflow.get_locks_by_owner(owner)\r\n    else:\r\n        locks = workflow.list_all_locks(include_expired=show_all)\r\n\r\n    if not locks:\r\n        click.echo(\"暂无锁定记录\")\r\n        return\r\n\r\n    headers = [\"锁ID\", \"匹配ID\", \"匹配编号\", \"匹配状态\", \"发票号\",               from datetime import datetime\r\n                expire_time = datetime.strptime(lock[\"lock_expires_at\"], \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n                if expire_time <= datetime.now():\r\n                    is_expired = \"是\"\r\n            except (ValueError, TypeError):\r\n                pass\r\n        rows.append([\r\n            lock[\"id\"],\r\n            lock[\"match_id\"],\r\n            lock[\"match_no\"],\r\n            STATUS_LABELS.get(lock.get(\"match_status\"), lock.get(\"match_status\", \"-\")),\r\n            lock[\"invoice_no\"],\r\n lock.get(\"lock_expires_at\", \"-\"),\r\n            is_expired,\r\n        ])\r\n    print_table(headers, rows)\r\n    click.echo(f\"\\n共 {len(locks)} help=\"锁定原因\")\r\n@click.pass_context\r\ndef lock_acquire(ctx, match_id, operator, reason):\r\n    \"\"\"锁定匹配记录\"\"\"\r\n    workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    try:\r\n        result = workflow.acquire_lock(match_id, operator, reason)\r\n        if result.get(\"skipped\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        elif result.get(\"already_locked\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        else:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[OK] {result['message']}\", fg=\"green\"))\r\n            click.echo(f\"匹配编号: {result['match_no']}\")\r\n            click.echo(f\"持有人: {result['owner']}\")\r\n            if result.get(\"expires_at\"):\r\n                click.echo(f\"到期时间: {result['expires_at']}\")\r\n    except ValueError as e:\r\n        click.echo(click.style(f\"[!!] {e}\", fg=\"red\"), err=True)\r\n        sys.exit(1)\r\n\r\n\r\n@lock.command(\"release\")\r\n@click.argument(\"match_id\", type=int)\r\n@click.option(\"--operator\", workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    try:\r\n        result = workflow.release_lock(match_id, operator, reason)\r\n        if result.get(\"skipped\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        elif result[\"success\"]:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[OK] {result['message']}\", fg=\"green\"))\r\n            click.echo(f\"匹配编号: {result['match_no']}\")\r\n            click.echo(f\"原持有人: {result['old_owner']}\")\r\n        else:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[!!] {result['message']}\", fg=\"red\"), err=True)\r\n            sys.exit(1)\r\n    except ValueError as e:\r\n        click.echo(click.style(f\"[!!] {e}\", fg=\"red\"),       "new_content": "import json\r\nimport csv\r\nimport os\r\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any, Tuple\r\nfrom datetime import datetime\r\nfrom .config import Config\r\nfrom .database \"amount_change\"\r\nCHANGE_TYPE_KEY_FIELD_CHANGE = \"key_field_change\"\r\nCHANGE_TYPE_DUPLICATE_PROCESS = \"duplicate_process\"\r\n\r\nCHANGE_TYPE_LABELS = {\r\n    CHANGE_TYPE_NEW_RECORD: \"ignored\"\r\n\r\nPROCESSING_STATUS_LABELS = {\r\n    PROCESSING_STATUS_PENDING: \"待处理\",\r\n    PROCESSING_STATUS_REVIEWED: \"已查看\",\r\n    PROCESSING_STATUS_RESOLVED: \"已解决\",\r\n    PROCESSING_STATUS_IGNORED: \"已忽略\",\r\n}\r\n\r\nKEY_FIELDS_INVOICE = [\"customer\", \"invoice_date\"]\r\nKEY_FIELDS_PAYMENT = [\"customer\", \"payment_date\"]\r\n\r\n\r\nclass ChangeTracker:\r\n    def __init__(self, config: Config, db: Database):\r\n        self.config = config\r\n        self.db = db\r\n\r\n    def _get_record_by_no(self, record_type: str, record_no: str,\r\n conn.execute(\r\n                        \"SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE invoice_no = ? AND batch_id = ?\",\r\n                        (record_no, batch_id)\r\n                    ).fetchone()\r\n                else:\r\n                    row = conn.execute(\r\n                        \"SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE invoice_no = ? ORDER BY batch_id DESC LIMIT 1\",\r\n                        (record_no,)\r\n                    ).fetchone()\r\n        else:\r\n            with self.db._get_conn() as conn:\r\n                if batch_id:\r\n                    row = conn.execute(\r\n                        \"SELECT * FROM payments WHERE payment_no = ? AND batch_id = ?\",\r\n                        (record_no, batch_id)\r\n                    ).fetchone()\r\n                else:\r\n                    row = conn.execute(\r\n                        \"SELECT * FROM payments WHERE payment_no = ? ORDER BY batch_id DESC LIMIT 1\",\r\n                        (record_no,)\r\n                    ).fetchone()\r\n        return dict(row) if row else None\r\n\r\n    def _get_related_matches(self, inv:\r\n                with self.db._get_conn() as conn:\r\n                    rows = conn.execute(\r\n                        \"\"\"SELECT m.*, i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                           FROM matches m\r\n                           JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id = i.id\r\n                           JOIN payments p ON m.payment_id = p.id\r\n                           WHERE i.invoice_no = ?\r\n                           ORDER BY m.created_at DESC\"\"\",\r\n                        (record_no,)\r\n                    ).fetchall()\r\n                    matches = [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n        else:\r\n            pay = self._get_record_by_no(\"payment\", record_no)\r\n            if pay:\r\n                with self.db._get_conn() as conn:\r\n                    rows = conn.execute(\r\n                        \"\"\"SELECT m.*, i.invoice_no, p.payment_no\r\n                           FROM matches m\r\n                           JOIN invoices i ON m.invoice_id                    (record_no,)\r\n                    ).fetchall()\r\n                    matches = [dict(r) for r in rows]\r\n        return matches\r\n\r\n    def _analyze_impact(self, record_type: str, record_no: str,\r\n                        change_type: str, field_name: str = None,\r\n                        old_value: Any = None, new_value: Any = None) -> Tuple[str, str, List[int]]:\r\n        matches = self._get_related_matches(record_type, record_no)\r\n        if not matches:\r\n            return IMPACT_TYPE_NONE, \"无相关匹配记录\", []\r\n\r\n        impact_type = IMPACT_TYPE_NONE\r\n impacted_ids.append(match_id)\r\n\r\n            if status == MATCH_STATUS_MATCHED:\r\n                if change_type == CHANGE_TYPE_AMOUNT_CHANGE and field_name == \"amount\":\r\n                    impact_type = IMPACT_TYPE_CRITICAL\r\n                    impact_details.append(\r\n                        f\"匹配 #{m['match_no']} 已确认，金额从 {old_value} 变为 {new_value} 将导致匹配失效\"\r\n                    )\r\n                elif change_type == CHANGE_TYPE_STATUS_CHANGE:\r\n                    impact_type = IMPACT_TYPE_CRITICAL\r\n                    impact_details.append(\r\n                        f\"匹配 #{m['match_no']} 已确认，记录状态变更可能需要重新核对\"\r\n                    )\r\n                else:\r\n                    if impact_type != IMPACT_TYPE_CRITICAL:\r\n                        impact_type = IMPACT_TYPE_CONFIRMED\r\n                    impact_details.append(\r\n                        f\"匹配 #{m['match_no']} 已确认，需评估变更影响\"\r\n                    )\r\n            elif status == MATCH_STATUS_PENDING:\r\n                if impact_type not in [IMPACT_TYPE_CRITICAL, IMPACT_TYPE_CONFIRMED]:\r\n                    impact_type = IMPACT_TYPE_PENDING\r\n                impact_details.append(\r\n                    f\"匹配 #{m['match_no']} 待确认，变更后可能需要重新匹配\"\r\n                )\r\n            elif status == MATCH_STATUS_REVOKED:\r\n                if impact_type == impact_details.append(\r\n                    f\"匹配 #{m['match_no']} 为异常状态，需关注变更\"\r\n                )\r\n\r\n        impact_detail_str = \"; \".join(impact_details) if impact_details else \"无相关匹配\"\r\n        return impact_type, impact_detail_str, impacted_ids\r\n\r\n    def _format_summary(self, record: Dict, record_type: str) -> str:\r\n        if record_type == \"invoice\":\r\n            return (\r\n                f\"发票号: {record.get('invoice_no', '-')}, \"\r\n                f\"客户: {record.get('customer', '-')}, \"\r\n                f\"日期: {record.get('invoice_date', '-')}, )\r\n        else:\r\n            return (\r\n                f\"收款号: {record.get('payment_no', '-')}, \"\r\n                f\"客户: {record.get('customer', '-')}, \"\r\n                f\"日期: {record.get('match_status', '-')}\"\r\n            )\r\n\r\n    def track_new_record(self, batch_id: int, record_type: str,\r\n                         record_no: str, new_record: Dict,\r\n self._format_summary(new_record, record_type)\r\n        impact_type, impact_details, impacted_ids = self._analyze_impact(\r\n            record_type, record_no, CHANGE_TYPE_NEW_RECORD\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        return self.db.insert_batch_change_log(\r\n            batch_id=batch_id,\r\n            change_type=CHANGE_TYPE_NEW_RECORD,\r\n            record_type=record_type,\r\n  impact_details=impact_details,\r\n            impacted_match_ids=impacted_ids,\r\n            operator=operator,\r\n            processing_status=PROCESSING_STATUS_PENDING,\r\n        )\r\n\r\n    def track_status_change(self, batch_id: int, record_type: str,\r\n                            record_no: str, old_record: Dict,\r\n                            new_record: Dict, old_status: str,\r\n   "new_string": "    def test_impact_on_pending_matches(self):\n        \"\"\"测试待确认匹配的影响分析\"\"\"\n        self.importer.import_invoices(self.invoice_v1, \"operator_a\")\n        self.importer.import_payments(self.payment_v1, \"operator_a\")\n        self.matcher.run_auto_matching(\"operator_a\")\n\n        matches = self.db.get_matches_by_status()\n        pending_count = 0\n        for m in matches:\n            if m[\"status\"] == MATCH_STATUS_PENDING:\n                pending_count += 1\n            elif m[\"status\"] == MATCH_STATUS_MATCHED:\n                self.db.confirm_match(m[\"id\"], \"operator_a\", \"确认匹配\")\n\n        pending_matches = self.db.get_matches_by_status(MATCH_STATUS_PENDING)\n        if pending_count == 0 and len(pending_matches) == 0:\n            all_matches = self.db.get_matches_by_status()\n            self.assertGreater(len(all_matches), 0, \"至少应有一些匹配\")\n        else:\n            self.assertGreater(pending_count + len(pending_matches), 0, \"应有匹配存在\")\n\n        result = self.importer.import_invoices(self.invoice_v2, \"operator_b\")\n\n        changes = self.db.get_batch_change_logs(batch_id=result[\"batch_id\"])\n\n        for c in changes:\n            self.assertIsNotNone(c[\"impact_type\"])\n            self.assertIsNotNone(c[\"impact_details\"])\n\n        impact_summary = result.get(\"impact_summary\", {})\n        self.assertIn(IMPACT_TYPE_PENDING, impact_summary)\n        self.assertIn(IMPACT_TYPE_CONFIRMED, impact_summary)",

95. finish
   params: {
  "summary": "## 实现完成总结\n\n已完成批次工作台重新导入变更追踪能力的完整实现，所有 124 个测试通过（含 21 个新增回归测试），真实 CLI 端到端验证全部通过。\n\n### 新增核心文件\n\n1. **[database.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/core/database.py)** - 新增 `batch_change_logs` 表\n   - 字段：变更类型、记录类型、记录编号、变更字段、原值、新值、变更前后摘要、影响类型、影响详情、影响的匹配ID、操作者、检测时间、处理状态、处理时间、处理人、备注\n   - 新增方法：`insert_batch_change_log()`、`get_batch_change_logs()`、`update_change_log_status()`\n\n2. **[change_tracker.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/core/change_tracker.py)** - 新增变更追踪核心模块\n   - **5 种变更类型**：新增记录、状态变更、金额变更、关键字段变更、重复处理\n   - **6 种影响类型**：无影响、影响待确认、影响已确认、影响已撤销、警告、严重\n   - **4 种处理状态**：待处理、已查看、已解决、已忽略\n   - 变更检测算法：对比新批次与所有历史批次的记录\n   - 影响分析：识别变更对已确认/待确认/已撤销匹配的影响程度\n   - 导出功能：JSON（单文件含摘要和明细）、CSV（摘要+明细双文件）\n\n3. **[test_change_tracking_regression.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/tests/test_change_tracking_regression.py)** - 21 个回归测试\n   - 变更检测核心测试（5个）\n   - 影响分析测试（4个）\n   - 导出功能测试（6个）\n   - 重启恢复测试（5个）\n   - 完整工作流测试（1个）\n\n### 修改的核心文件\n\n1. **[importer.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/core/importer.py)** - 集成变更追踪\n   - 导入后自动调用 `detect_and_track_changes()`\n   -    - 字段：变更类型、记录类型、记录编号、变更字段、原值、新值、变更前后摘要、影响类型、影响详情、影响的匹配ID、操作者、检测时间、处理状态、处理时间、处理人、备注
   - 新增方法：`insert_batch_change_log()`、`get_batch_change_logs()`、`update_change_log_status()`

   - **5 种变更类型**：新增记录、状态变更、金额变更、关键字段变更、重复处理
   - **6 种影响类型**：无影响、影响待确认、影响已确认、影响已撤销、警告、严重

   - 影响分析：识别变更对已确认/待确认/已撤销匹配的影响程度

   - `batch export-changes <batch_id>` - 导出变更日志（JSON/CSV 格式）

### 导出稳定性保证

**JSON 格式** 稳定包含：
- 导出信息（导出时间、导出人、批次ID、文件名、文件类型、导入时间、导入人）
- 统计摘要（按变更类型、按影响类型、按处理状态）
- 变更明细（22个字段：日志ID、批次ID、来源文件、变更类型、记录类型、记录编号、变更字段、原值、新值、变更摘要、变更前摘要、变更后摘要、影响类型、影响详情、影响的匹配ID、处理状态、操作者、检测时间、处理时间、处理人、备注）

**CSV 格式** 稳定包含：
- `变更摘要.csv` - 批次信息+统计汇总
- `变更明细.csv` - 所有变更记录的完整字段

### 重启恢复能力

程序重启后自动恢复：
1. 上次选中的批次
2. 筛选条件（处理人、状态）
3. 上次导出上下文（批次ID、导出类型、格式、导出时间）
4. 上次查看变更上下文（批次ID、过滤条件）

### 端到端验证结果

真实命令验证全部通过：
```
1. import invoices v1 → 成功导入 5 条
2. import payments v1 → 成功导入 5 条
3. match → 自动匹配 5 条
4. import invoices v2 → 检测到 4 条变更、8 个冲突
   变更：状态变更×1、关键字段变更×1、金额变更×1、新增记录×1
   影响：严重×2、影响已确认×1、无影响×1
5. batch changes --batch-id 3 → 显示 4 条变更明细
6. batch changes --batch-id 3 --change-type amount_change → 过滤显示
7. batch export-changes 3 --format json → 导出 JSON
8. batch export-changes 3 --format csv → 导出 CSV
9. batch change-status 3 --status reviewed → 更新处理状态
10. batch resume-export → 使用保存的上下文恢复导出
11. batch filter --operator operator_a --status matched → 设置筛选条件
12. status → 显示完整会话恢复信息
```

所有用户可见输出均包含完整的中文标签和说明，可直接用于交接。

pass\r\n\r\n\r\n@lock.command(\"list\")\r\n@click.option(\"--all\", \"show_all\", is_flag=True, help=\"显示所有锁（包括已过期）\")\r\n@click.option(\"--owner\", default=None, workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    current_operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    if owner:\r\n        locks = workflow.get_locks_by_owner(owner)\r\n    else:\r\n        locks = workflow.list_all_locks(include_expired=show_all)\r\n\r\n    if not locks:\r\n        click.echo(\"暂无锁定记录\")\r\n        return\r\n\r\n    headers = [\"锁ID\", \"匹配ID\", \"匹配编号\", \"匹配状态\", \"发票号\",               from datetime import datetime\r\n                expire_time = datetime.strptime(lock[\"lock_expires_at\"], \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\r\n                if expire_time <= datetime.now():\r\n                    is_expired = \"是\"\r\n            except (ValueError, TypeError):\r\n                pass\r\n        rows.append([\r\n            lock[\"id\"],\r\n            lock[\"match_id\"],\r\n            lock[\"match_no\"],\r\n            STATUS_LABELS.get(lock.get(\"match_status\"), lock.get(\"match_status\", \"-\")),\r\n            lock[\"invoice_no\"],\r\n lock.get(\"lock_expires_at\", \"-\"),\r\n            is_expired,\r\n        ])\r\n    print_table(headers, rows)\r\n    click.echo(f\"\\n共 {len(locks)} help=\"锁定原因\")\r\n@click.pass_context\r\ndef lock_acquire(ctx, match_id, operator, reason):\r\n    \"\"\"锁定匹配记录\"\"\"\r\n    workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    try:\r\n        result = workflow.acquire_lock(match_id, operator, reason)\r\n        if result.get(\"skipped\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        elif result.get(\"already_locked\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        else:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[OK] {result['message']}\", fg=\"green\"))\r\n            click.echo(f\"匹配编号: {result['match_no']}\")\r\n            click.echo(f\"持有人: {result['owner']}\")\r\n            if result.get(\"expires_at\"):\r\n                click.echo(f\"到期时间: {result['expires_at']}\")\r\n    except ValueError as e:\r\n        click.echo(click.style(f\"[!!] {e}\", fg=\"red\"), err=True)\r\n        sys.exit(1)\r\n\r\n\r\n@lock.command(\"release\")\r\n@click.argument(\"match_id\", type=int)\r\n@click.option(\"--operator\", workflow = ctx.obj[\"workflow\"]\r\n    operator = operator or get_current_user()\r\n\r\n    try:\r\n        result = workflow.release_lock(match_id, operator, reason)\r\n        if result.get(\"skipped\"):\r\n            click.echo(click.style(result[\"message\"], fg=\"yellow\"))\r\n        elif result[\"success\"]:\r\n            click.echo(click.style(f\"[OK] {result['message']}\", fg=\"green\"))\r\n            click.echo(f\"匹配编号: {result['match_no']}\")\r\n            click.echo(f\"原持有人: {result['old_owner']}\")\r\n        else:\r\n ### 最终输出/回复候选
1. ## 修复完成总结

### 根因定位

在 [main.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/cli/main.py#L1833-L1848) 的 `batch_changes` 函数中，`workbench` 对象仅在 `if batch_id:` 条件分支内初始化：

```python
if batch_id:
    workbench = ctx.obj["workbench"]   # 只在这里初始化
    workbench.save_last_selected_batch(batch_id, get_current_user())

workbench.save_change_view_context(...)  # 分支外直接调用 → 不带 batch_id 时 UnboundLocalError
```

当用户不带 `--batch-id` 参数执行 `batch changes` 时，`if batch_id` 条件为 False，`workbench` 从未绑定，第 1842 行直接抛 `UnboundLocalError`。

### 最小改动修复

两处改动：

1. **[main.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/cli/main.py#L1833-L1848)**：将 `workbench = ctx.obj["workbench"]` 从 `if batch_id:` 分支内移到函数最前面，确保不论是否带批次参数，workbench 都可用。

2. **[main.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/invoice_reconciler/cli/main.py#L132-L153)**：启动时恢复查看上下文的逻辑中，当用户是默认查看"全部批次"（`batch_id` 为 None）时，显式显示 `全部批次` 而不是静默跳过，让用户明确知道会话已恢复。

### 新增回归测试

在 [test_change_tracking_regression.py](file:///d:/workSpace/AI__SPACE/zyx-00118/tests/test_change_tracking_regression.py#L885-L1082) 新增 `TestBatchChangesCLIEntrypoints` 测试类，5 个测试：

| 测试 | 覆盖点 |
|---|---|
| `test_batch_changes_without_batch_id_no_crash` | 稳定复现旧的 UnboundLocalError，确认修复后不带参数不崩溃 |
| `test_batch_changes_with_batch_id_works` | 带 batch_id 入口正常输出明细 |
| `test_batch_changes_two_entries_context_not_polluted` | 不带参数 → 带参数 → 不带参数 三步骤，确认上下文互不污染，来回切换 batch_id 正确 |
| `test_batch_changes_view_filter_persists` | 过滤条件持久化：保存 change_type/impact_type/status，切换到带 batch_id 时不保留旧过滤器 |
